name: Vervoe
summary: Vervoe builds skills assessments from real job tasks. Its FAQ says integrity checks flag copy-paste, tab switching and AI-generated answers, and its homepage describes continuous identity proctoring. Its machine learning models score responses. The vendor publishes no price.

facts.text: The homepage describes its skills assessments as built on real job tasks.
The FAQ says integrity checks run on every response, flagging copy-paste, tab switching and AI-generated answers.
The homepage refers to continuous identity proctoring tied to identity verification. The page does not describe webcam monitoring or a locked browser.
The homepage says proprietary machine learning models learn from the team's grading and score responses based on the team's preferences.
The homepage links to a pricing section, but the text read shows no figures or currency.

plans.name: Vervoe (quote only)
plans.unit: not stated on the vendor pages read
plans.notes: The vendor publishes no price. Its pages show a Pricing link and a free trial, but no figures.

hiddenCosts: The vendor publishes no price, so the cost of any plan must be requested from the vendor.
